subject: BlueYard activation hiccup — PO consolidation & line-item repair
body:
---Message 1 of 5---
From: Alice Park <alice.park@blueyard.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup — BlueYard Logistics (onboarding form attached)

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding packet and a sample invoice so procurement can issue a PO and we can start the integration.

A few notes:
- Requested initial spend cap: $125,000 (monthly, for first 3 months while volume ramps)
- Billing contact: billing@blueyard.co
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (we've included it in the attached form)

Attachment: blueyard_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: blueyard_invoice_sample.xlsx (xlsx)

Let me know if you need anything else to issue the PO.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Ops | BlueYard Logistics
---

---Message 2 of 5---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@blueyard.co>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — BlueYard Logistics (onboarding form attached)

Hi Alice — thanks, and welcome.

Quick confirmation items before we request PO issuance from finance:
1) Tax ID looks good but can you confirm the legal entity name exactly as it appears on invoices (we need it verbatim for the PO)?
2) For spend cap: procurement typically starts with a provisional PO at the lower of (a) requested cap or (b) sales committed forecast. Can you confirm you accept a provisional PO at $75,000 while we validate traffic over 30 days? If not, note what lines are essential to prioritize.
3) Do you have a preferred PO line breakdown (e.g., onboarding fee, monthly platform usage, per-shipment fee)? If you send a suggested split we can mirror it in the PO to avoid later line-item corrections.

I cc'd Markus from Finance to keep him in the loop for the initial issuance.

Thanks — I'll start the request once you confirm.

--
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
---

---Message 3 of 5---
From: Alice Park <alice.park@blueyard.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup — BlueYard Logistics (onboarding form attached)

Hi Monica,

Legal name for invoices: BlueYard Logistics, Inc. (exact).
We can accept a provisional PO at $75,000 for the first 30 days — that works for our onboarding window.

Suggested line split:
- Line 1: Onboarding professional services — $10,000 (one-time)
- Line 2: Monthly platform connectivity fee — $5,000
- Line 3: Per-shipment processing (variable) — estimate $60,000 cap for month 1

We prefer the PO to reflect these three lines. If procurement needs to collapse/merge lines for system reasons we can accept that as long as the invoice references the PO and line totals.

Thanks again — ready when you are.

Regards,
Alice
---

---Message 4 of 5---
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@blueyard.co>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: ACTION: BlueYard provisioning — two provisional POs created (race condition) causing spend cap conflict

Team — heads-up and ask for manual remediation.

Summary: During back-end provisioning we hit a race condition in the PO-allocator that caused two provisional PO numbers to be created for BlueYard for overlapping date ranges: PO# PRV-98321 (system-created) and PO# PRV-98322 (retry path). Both were assigned a spend cap; PRV-98321 shows $75,000, PRV-98322 shows $0 (stale), but PRV-98321 was erroneously marked "locked" in the master ledger because a duplicate claim was attached to a different merchant token. The duplicate lock is preventing invoices from being applied to the correct PO and is triggering our spend-safeguard hold, so BlueYard's invoices are being auto-rejected by the billing pipeline.

What I need:
- Karthik: can you manually consolidate PRV-98321 and PRV-98322 into a single canonical PO (final PO to be PO-2026-11047) and restore the $75,000 spend cap on that canonical record? Please ensure the ledger points to BlueYard Logistics, Inc. (legal name) and that the three requested lines are preserved as separate line items where possible.
- Markus: once Karthik confirms consolidation, can Finance lift the temporary auto-reject rule for BlueYard invoices until EOD Monday so they can bill onboarding fees? We'll capture reconciliation in the weekly procurement ledger.

Suggested surgical sequence (minimize downstream risk):
1) Snapshot current ledger entries for PRV-98321 and PRV-98322 (audit key PROC-1298).
2) Create canonical PO PO-2026-11047 with the $75,000 cap and the three lines (see Alice's split).
3) Reassign any invoice claims currently attached to PRV-98321/98322 to PO-2026-11047.
4) Remove the duplicate lock marker from the old provisional entries and mark them as "merged - void" so historical audit trails remain intact.

Impact if delayed: BlueYard's onboarding professional services invoice (~$9,500) will be rejected and onboarding will stall. They indicated that causes a week delay to integration which cascades to revenue recognition.

Attachments: snapshot log (system will generate PROC-1298 export).

Can we aim to have the canonical PO created and the hold lifted by 6pm PT today? If not, propose an alternate window.

Thanks — I can coordinate with BlueYard if you want them to hold off sending more invoices until we resolve.

--
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
---

---Message 5 of 5---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@blueyard.co>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACTION: BlueYard provisioning — two provisional POs created (race condition) causing spend cap conflict

Monica — thanks for the clear runbook. I captured the steps and will take ownership.

Planned actions now:
- I will snapshot PROC-1298 and create PO-2026-11047 by 12:30pm PT.
- I will preserve the three-line structure; if the ERP prevents 3 lines I will create a combined line with a comment mapping to the original breakdown.
- Markus — can you please confirm you can lift the auto-reject for BlueYard invoices until COB Monday once I confirm the new PO is live? If not, tell me the latest you can allow.

Alice — once I publish PO-2026-11047 I'll share the PO PDF here and the procurement tracker link so you can reference it on invoices. Apologies for the churn — this was a backend allocation race, not anything on your side.

If anything blocks creation I will escalate to infra (tagging PROC-1298 and INFRA-4321).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Procurement Engineer | Redwood Inference
